stories.title: Katie Zacharia out as press secretary after five days
stories.summary: Katie Zacharia was out as White House press secretary five days after starting, following a debut briefing of under 15 minutes in which she called her husband "my president," a South Lawn answer of "When I moved to China" when asked where she passed the bar, and a Wall Street Journal report that she had failed the California bar exam. Her tenure became a unit of time on the spot ("Half of a Scaramucci is called a Zacharia"), Wikipedia's list of humorous units of measurement added the "Zacharia," Scaramucci posted "Records are made to be broken. But I take no pleasure in other people's pain" (27K likes), #OpenToWork memes followed, and the Lincoln Project's Liz Truss-style lettuce from day one ("Can Katie Zacharia outlast this lettuce?") had its answer. Her exit post calling Trump "kind, wonderful, gracious" drew 93K likes and a pile of mocking quote-posts.

stories.title: Katie Zacharia out as press secretary after five days
stories.summary: Katie Zacharia was out as White House press secretary five days after starting, after a debut briefing of under 15 minutes and a Wall Street Journal report that she had failed the bar exam. Anthony Scaramucci, whose 11 days set the old record, posted "Records are made to be broken. But I take no pleasure in other people's pain" (27K likes), and "half a Scaramucci" became the joke of the day.
